title: Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts

translated_title: 该选择哪个大语言模型？面向大语言模型的在线主动模型选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01592v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被应用于处理流式数据，从业者依赖基准测试来选择最佳模型，尽管这些信号只能近似真实性能。虽然专家标注可以提供可靠的反馈，但其成本高昂且难以大规模获取。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ONLINE LLM PICKER，这是首个面向在线环境下大语言模型的主动模型选择框架。给定任意的查询流和有限的标注预算，ONLINE LLM PICKER会选择最具信息量的提示词进行标注，从而在候选模型中识别出最佳的LLM。在涵盖10个数据集的多个任务上，针对超过130个语言模型，我们展示了ONLINE LLM PICKER可节省高达71.67%的标注成本，同时可靠地识别出针对该数据流的最佳或接近最佳的模型。我们还展示了使用返回的模型对未标注提示词进行序列生成（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出首个面向在线场景的大语言模型主动模型选择框架ONLINE LLM PICKER，通过挑选最具信息量的提示词进行标注，在有限预算下节省高达71.67%的标注成本，并可靠识别出处理流式数据的最佳或接近最佳的模型。
en_tdlr: ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for online active model selection of LLMs, identifies the best or near-best model on streaming queries while saving up to 71.67% annotation cost by actively selecting the most informative prompts for annotation.
